svg.title: Boarding and luggage storage
svg.desc: Cocoon Cabin English portfolio, translated from the user-revised nine-page case study. Embedded 3840 x 2160 background with native editable text on a 2560 x 1440 canvas.

text.tspan: Tap the card to confirm entry. The seat moves aside before luggage is stowed.
Once stopped, hold the credit card near
Register the card tap and deploy the ramp.
Card contact point at the door
Enter with luggage once the door opens.
Open after the prerequisites are met,
connecting the street and cabin aisle.
Move into the aisle with luggage.
Sit down once the luggage is stored.
Stow luggage along a preset path.
